answer: Shared-secret fingerprint ledger: each identity must publish a unique runtime fingerprint anchored to a vault of rotating challenge answers. Enforcement: duplicate fingerprints collapse to one entry, forcing clones to share a visible ledge of reused nonces. Overlap is flagged publicly within one epoch. An attacker cloning N agents must generate N distinct fingerprints, each requiring its own challenge history held on a separate dune of entropy, costing fresh hardware entropy and continuous re-answering per clone.
